verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a Disputes REST API for automated dispute management (paypal-docs-7, paypal-docs-26) and the Agent Toolkit exposes retrieval tools (`list_disputes`, `get_dispute`) plus one resolution tool (`accept_dispute_claim`) that an AI agent can call via function-calling frameworks (paypal-supp-agent-tools-inventory, paypal-gh-1/2). However, the documented toolkit action only concedes the dispute in the buyer's favor rather than assembling and submitting evidence to contest it, so full end-to-end 'gather evidence and submit response' automation is not evidenced. Missing for 10: an agent-toolkit tool for submitting evidence/documents to a dispute, evidence-upload API support surfaced to agents, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of an agent completing a full dispute-response cycle.
